name: ROBOT_F_CONTROLLED
meaning: player input goes to the robot (Robot_IsControllable); set by TakeControl and by msg 0xF

name: ROBOT_F_TOUCHING_MOVABLE
meaning: per frame: Robot_Move contact.movableObj; blocks put-down and dormancy

name: ROBOT_F_ON_OBJECT
meaning: per frame: standing on a scenaric object; suppresses the camera ledge probe

name: ROBOT_F_DRIVEN
meaning: robot owns the camera request; msg 0x3681 (read by WoodenLift, CameraRestriction and LightSpot)

name: ROBOT_F_DEAD
meaning: ignores msg 0, 0x3F, 0xB/0x25 and the death-zone test until Reset

name: ROBOT_F_SMOKE_PHASE
meaning: toggled by smokeFlickerTimer; smoke spawns only when set

name: ROBOT_F_AXIS_LOCK_A
meaning: per frame (msg 0x44 arg 0): heading snapped to 0x400/0xC00

name: ROBOT_F_AXIS_LOCK_B
meaning: per frame (msg 0x44 arg 1): heading snapped to 0/0x800

name: ROBOT_F_POWERED_ON
meaning: power-on anim (state 3) already played; cleared by Reset

name: ROBOT_F_IN_SHADOW
meaning: inside a g_shadowBoxes zone this frame; tint 0xC00

name: ROBOT_F_DEATH_FALLS
meaning: death anim keeps gravity and ends in SetState(1) (msg 0 kill, water, most death boxes)
